decisions.reason: A low-cost burner component that supports the established radiant-heater range keeps its option value, and nothing so far shows its value is unlikely to be realized.
The electric infrared panel line is a flagship of the firm's electrification direction and is still early in resolving its uncertainty, so the option is worth preserving.
This multi-model industrial electric hall heater sits close to the core customer base and benefits from electrification demand, so keeping it costs little and its prospects remain promising.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a proven real-world installation and offers a valuable growth option toward low-carbon heating.
